# v1.0.8 — the S37/S38 analyses and the current manuscript title

This release closes the two gaps the second-round peer review found in the reproducibility package: the analyses added to the revised manuscript had no archived generator, and the Zenodo record still carried the pre-revision title.

## What changed

- `code/charls_only/98_full_awgs_icc.R` regenerates **Supplementary Table S37** (complete AWGS 2019 possible-sarcopenia definition in all 6,052 participants: 2,181 labels, 1,070 not reproduced, reversion 49.1%, 95% CI 46.2-51.8) and **Supplementary Table S38** (short-interval ICC 0.80-0.99 sensitivity: expected reversion 42.8% to 9.7%, error share of two-year change variance 51.3% to 2.6%).
- `code/charls_only/99_full_awgs_cc.R` runs the chair-stand complete-case check (5,494 participants, reversion 49.6%), showing the definition effect is not an artefact of missing performance data.
- `manifest/s37_s38/` holds the four aggregate CSV outputs; `manifest/outputs.csv` now maps S37 and S38 to their generators.
- `.zenodo.json` and `CITATION.cff` now carry the current manuscript title and `version: 1.0.8`; `DATA_AVAILABILITY.md` names this version.

The scripts run against the CHARLS release and `out/jamda_full.rds`; they contain no machine-specific paths and no respondent-level data. No estimate in the manuscript changed.

Cite this version, or the concept DOI `10.5281/zenodo.23677282`, which resolves here. Version 1.0.7 remains citable at its own version DOI.
